global.courtesyName: International Energy Agency (IEA) — Global Battery Storage Capacity Additions, 2020-2025

items.label: Cumulative Installed Capacity
items.note: IEA-confirmed total. Adding 2025's reported additions brings the estimate to ≈232 GW by end of 2025 — that combined figure is our own arithmetic, not a number IEA has stated directly.

items.label: New Capacity Added (2025)
items.note: 40% more than 2024 additions; installed base is now ~11x higher than in 2021.

items.label: 5-Year Growth (2020 → 2024)
items.note: Utility-scale battery power capacity additions grew more than twelvefold over 2020-2024, before a further 40% jump in 2025.

items.label: Utility-Scale Share
items.note: Share of 2025's new battery capacity that was utility-scale rather than distributed/behind-the-meter.

items.label: Leading Market
items.note: Share of global 2025 additions from China, followed by the United States and Europe.

items.label: Dominant Chemistry
items.note: Share of 2025 deployments using lithium iron phosphate cells.

items.label: 2030 Storage Target
items.note: IEA estimate of total global storage capacity (all technologies) needed by 2030 to support tripling renewable capacity.
